deadline.value: The early fall deadline is February 15, 2027; later deadlines are April 15 and July 15. International applicants must submit by May 1.
deadline.quote: February 15 (early) April 15 (regular) and July 15 (late) for fall semester

also.quote: All international application materials must be submitted by May 1 for fall admission

gre_general.value: GRE is required when the degree is from an institution not accredited by a US regional agency; the department may waive it for a last-degree GPA of 3.5 or more or two years of US engineering work.
gre_general.quote: Applicants must submit official scores from the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) if they graduated from an institution not accredited by a regional accrediting agency of the USA

also.quote: Applicant’s overall GPA from last degree is at least 3.5 on a 4.0 scale

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE applies to this field.

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee; you identify an advisor after you join.
supervisor.quote: students must identify an advisor, who will direct and guide the progress of their program

funding.value: The page gives no funding rule.

entry_route.value: A master's from an accredited institution is normally required; strong undergraduates can apply straight to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Normally a master’s degree from an accredited institution is required for admission

also.quote: students with outstanding undergraduate records may apply directly for admission to the doctoral program

notes: The Systems Engineering PhD is offered in the same school. It is not a field in the Atlas list, so it is not saved.
name: Mechanical Engineering, PhD
